Lovely staff, good food
Mar 2018 • Family
We went here on our last day in HCMC. We love traditional food, but this time we were in the mood for Indian food. 
As a celiac it might be hard to go out for dinner, especially abroad. But at Mumtaz I showed my translation card and they really understood it. They told me what I could and couldn't eat. The food was very nice and the staff is also very polite. 
Overall, it was a good experience.

Absolutely delicious Indian food (true taste) here in Ho Chi Minh.(Must Visit At Least Once..and you will be back again)
Mar 2018 • Business
Don't let the simplicity of this place due to the absence of decor.. give you an initial negative opinion...You are here to eat tasty Indian food...that is just what you will get.
Step inside for a taste of the best delicious Indian food you will find here in Ho Chi Minh.
I can safely assure you that each dish is prepared dedicatedly to ensure an authentic tasty reflection of what you seek.
Service is always with a smile and genuine concern for detailed satisfaction.
Do not let any negative review here deter you ...as perhaps those reviewers are probably just jealous competitors or cheap persons looking to stretch their Vietnam dongs. 
Good food comes at a price and it is still adequately priced for its excellent quality.
If you need any specifics in your meal...be sure to tell them while placing your order...and they will oblige you ensuring your meal is to your liking.
